en: “Wh-What are you doing?!”
“It's time for you to fulfill your promise.”
“You said you'd do anything for me.”
“Yeah.”
“I was the one who ate that can of herring last time.”
“Yeah... but I didn't know about that.”
“I saved your ass.”
“Well, what do you want to do to me?”
I take out a bag of clothes and give it to Shizuko.
“I want you to wear this.”
“What, did you get this from a sex shop?”
“Is this a cow outfit?”
“I think it'd look great on you.”
“Are you sick in the head?!”
“You think I'm going to wear this for you?!”
“Look at how much is exposed. Only a bimbo would wear this.”
Even though she's complaining, Shizuko walks into the bathroom with the clothes.
When she comes out, she's wearing the cow outfit.
“Can you moo for me?”
“Can you shut the fuck up?”
“Mooooo...”
“Hey, do you have a boner?!”
“How could I not be hard right now?”
“Do you wanna...?”
“Hey, don't tell me what to do...”
“I'm not giving you an order. I could only ask you to do one thing, and you already did it.”
“But... do you want to?”
“...Yeah. Make it quick.”
